extension.news:

v0.33.3 - Kodi 22 settings-label hotfix - Replaces unsupported literal category and setting labels with localized numeric string IDs. - Adds current resource.language.en_gb and resource.language.id_id catalogs. - Restores all category and setting names in Kodi 22 / Arctic Fuse 3. - Keeps database, DBID handoff, DBID reuse validation, providers, and artwork behavior unchanged.
v0.33.2 - Kodi 22 launch and settings hotfix - Removes a stale import of the deleted legacy maintenance module. - Declares empty string settings as allow-empty for Kodi 22. - Keeps the R7 fresh-schema baseline, active DBID handoff, DBID reuse validation, provider fallback, and atomic writes unchanged.
v0.33.1 - Clean fresh-install baseline - Creates the final artwork database schema directly. - Removes historical schema migration, title-specific repair, collision-repair, and added-event fallback paths. - Startup auto-fill uses exact scan DBID delta only. - Keeps active DBID handoff so the same movie or episode can move from MKV to STRM without artwork scraping. - Keeps normal provider fallback, identity validation, generated local thumbnails, atomic writes, diagnostics, and 58-character family notifications.

extension.summary: Fast automatic and manual Indonesian subtitles from SubSource with community-first ranking.
Subtitle Indonesia otomatis dan manual dari SubSource.
extension.description: Uses embedded or matching local Indonesian text directly. Every text subtitle path, including automatic, manual, local, embedded, RAW and synchronized profiles, passes through an always-on ad, watermark and fan-credit cleaner while timing, closed captions and styling tags remain intact. When the MKV or its folder contains a usable matching English text subtitle, Indonesian candidates are synchronized to that exact-video reference. Without embedded text, the add-on downloads top Indonesian subtitles with original timing and F3 cycles them. Online English is never used automatically; it is available only through manual search and can be confirmed with Shift+F3 before synchronizing Indonesian candidates. Image subtitles such as PGS/SUP, VobSub, and DVB are ignored. A visible Settings button exports a sanitized diagnostic ZIP.

Memakai subtitle Indonesia teks embedded atau lokal yang cocok secara langsung. Semua jalur subtitle teks, termasuk otomatis, manual, lokal, embedded, RAW, dan hasil sinkronisasi, selalu melewati pembersih iklan, watermark, dan kredit fan-sub tanpa mengubah timing, closed caption, maupun tag tampilan. Jika MKV atau foldernya memiliki subtitle Inggris teks yang cocok, kandidat Indonesia disinkronkan ke referensi dari video tersebut. Tanpa referensi teks terpercaya, addon mengunduh kandidat Indonesia teratas dengan timing asli dan F3 mengganti hasil RAW. Subtitle Inggris online tidak pernah dipakai otomatis; hanya tersedia melalui pencarian manual. PGS/SUP, VobSub, dan DVB diabaikan. Tombol di Settings mengekspor ZIP diagnostics yang sudah disanitasi.
